title: The top attractions in Sydney: iconic sights & experiences | Sydney.com
facts: Destination NSW lists the Opera House, Harbour Bridge, Bondi Beach, The Rocks, Royal Botanic Garden, Art Gallery of NSW, Taronga Zoo, Chinatown, Museum of Contemporary Art and Manly ferry among Sydney’s attractions.
The Opera House is at Bennelong Point; the exterior and performance/tour visits are different experiences.
Manly ferries depart Circular Quay; the source suggests continuing from Manly’s Corso to its beach.
The Royal Botanic Garden adjoins the harbour and Opera House; the Museum of Contemporary Art is at Circular Quay.
Bondi can be reached by public transport and connects with coastal walking opportunities.
confidence: official-source; editorial review limited to listed stable facts
notes: Stable place and visitor-planning facts only. Prices, opening hours, event schedules and safety guarantees are deliberately omitted; consult operators for current conditions.
